messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Below is a concise list of the long‑weekend holidays that Canadians can expect in 2023.  
These are the federal holidays that fall on a weekday (or are observed on a weekday when they fall on a weekend) and therefore create a three‑day weekend for most of the country.

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed Day (if weekend) | Typical Long‑Weekend Dates |
|---------|-------------|---------------------------|----------------------------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Sunday, Jan 1 | – | Dec 30 – Jan 1 |
| **Family Day** (Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island) | Monday, Feb 20 | – | Feb 18 – 20 |
| **Good Friday** | Friday, Apr 7 | – | Apr 7 – 9 |
| **Victoria Day** | Monday, May 22 | – | May 20 – 22 |
| **Canada Day** | Saturday, Jul 1 | Observed Monday, Jul 3 | Jun 30 – Jul 1 |
| **Labour Day** | Monday, Sep 4 | – | Sep 2 – 4 |
| **Thanksgiving** | Monday, Oct 9 | – | Oct 7 – 9 |
| **Remembrance Day** | Friday, Nov 11 | – | Nov 11 – 13 |
| **Christmas Day** | Monday, Dec 25 | – | Dec 23 – 25 |
| **Boxing Day** | Tuesday, Dec 26 | – | Dec 26 – 28 |

> **Note:**  
> • Some provinces have additional holidays that create long weekends (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador on Mar 17, Saint‑Jean‑Baptiste Day in Quebec on Jun 24).  
> • If a holiday falls on a weekend, the federal government usually observes it on the following Monday (as with Canada Day in 2023).  

Feel free to integrate this table into your holiday‑planning app!
